# Nectra Digital

> Nectra Digital is an enterprise digital growth and technology agency headquartered in India. The company specializes in technical search engine optimization (SEO), performance marketing (PPC), custom AI workflow automation, web development, and software engineering. Founded by Ravindra Kumar Chauhan, Nectra Digital operates across 20+ Indian metropolitan hubs and delivers verified growth outcomes for local, national, and international clients.

## Core Services

- [SEO Services India](https://www.nectradigital.com/seo-services): Professional search engine optimization services for Indian and global brands, covering technical audits, on-page architecture, link acquisition, and monthly reporting.
- [Local SEO Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/local-seo-services): Google Business Profile (GBP/GMB) optimization, local map pack rankings, citation building, and multi-location SEO across 20+ cities.
- [Technical SEO Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/technical-seo-services): Core Web Vitals optimization, crawl budget management, indexation fixes, JavaScript SEO, and structured data implementation.
- [Enterprise SEO Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/enterprise-seo-services): Scalable organic search strategies for high-traffic platforms, programmatic architectures, and global domains.
- [Performance Marketing Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/performance-marketing-services): Multi-channel paid acquisition combining Google Search, Display, Meta Ads, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- [Google Ads Management](https://www.nectradigital.com/google-ads-management): High-intent search advertising, shopping campaigns, YouTube video ads, and remarketing funnels.
- [Meta Ads Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/meta-ads-services): Paid social media campaigns on Facebook and Instagram engineered for e-commerce and B2B lead generation.
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/digital-marketing-services): Integrated digital marketing campaigns combining organic visibility, paid channels, and analytics.
- [Social Media Marketing Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/social-media-marketing-services): Organic brand building, content distribution, community management, and paid social synergy.
- [AI Automation Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/ai-automation-services): Custom workflow automations, CRM synchronization, autonomous agent pipelines, and webhook connectors.
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://www.nectradigital.com/ai-chatbot-development): Intelligent website chatbots built with large language models (LLMs) to qualify inbound leads 24/7.
- [WhatsApp AI Bot Development](https://www.nectradigital.com/whatsapp-ai-bot-development): Official WhatsApp Business API integrations for automated customer support and transaction booking.
- [Web Development Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/web-development-services): Custom website development built on modern, secure stacks optimized for sub-second load times and high conversions.
- [Software Development Services](https://www.nectradigital.com/software-development-services): Full-stack custom software engineering, internal business tools, and enterprise SaaS platforms.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.nectradigital.com/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications built on Flutter and React Native.
- [E-commerce Development](https://www.nectradigital.com/ecommerce-development): Custom storefronts, headless Shopify builds, and WooCommerce setups engineered for high checkout velocity.

## Industries

- Healthcare: Medical practices, diagnostic clinics, hospital networks, and telehealth platforms.
- Real Estate: Property developers, commercial realty brokers, and residential real estate agencies.
- Education: EdTech startups, educational institutions, coaching academies, and universities.
- Finance & FinTech: Banking software, payment gateway dashboards, wealth management, and loan portals.
- E-commerce: Direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, multi-vendor marketplaces, and headless Shopify stores.
- Startups & SaaS: B2B software platforms, MVP engineering, and product-led organic search engines.
- Enterprise: High-traffic legacy web architectures requiring custom software refactoring and enterprise SEO.
